  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Sales" name="Sales and Order Placement" isExecutable="false">

      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SalesStaff" name="Sales Staff / Customer Support">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Inquiry</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectInformation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Interested</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GuideSelection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_NotInterested</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RecordOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_OrderPlaced</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SalesRep" name="Sales Representative">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideQuote</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendQuote</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_QuoteApproved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Inquiry" name="Inquiry received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Inquiry" messageRef="Message_Inquiry"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CollectInformation" name="Collect relevant information and address concerns"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Interested" name="Customer interested?" default="Flow_NotInterested"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_GuideSelection" name="Guide customer through product or service selection"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotInterested" name="Inquiry closed without order"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvideQuote" name="Provide quote"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendQuote" name="Send quote to customer" messageRef="Message_Quote"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_QuoteApproved" name="Quote approved by customer">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Approval" messageRef="Message_Approval"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RecordOrder" name="Record order in system"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation to customer" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderPlaced" name="Order placed and confirmed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Collect" sourceRef="StartEvent_Inquiry" targetRef="Task_CollectInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_CollectInformation" targetRef="Gateway_Interested"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Interested" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Interested" targetRef="Task_GuideSelection">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${customerInterested == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInterested" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Interested" targetRef="End_NotInterested"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guide_Quote" sourceRef="Task_GuideSelection" targetRef="Task_ProvideQuote"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Quote_Send" sourceRef="Task_ProvideQuote" targetRef="Task_SendQuote"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Send_Approval" sourceRef="Task_SendQuote" targetRef="Event_QuoteApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approval_Record" sourceRef="Event_QuoteApproved" targetRef="Task_RecordOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Record_Confirmation" sourceRef="Task_RecordOrder" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirmation_End" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="End_OrderPlaced"/>
